title: Unit Event — On the Stage of Dazzling Light — Episode6 That Night Sky I Saw

meta.Event: On the Stage of Dazzling Light
meta.Episode: Episode6 — That Night Sky I Saw
meta.Event Outline: Ever since his visit to Riley Dream Park, Tsukasa has felt a desire to improve even more as an actor. In the troupe's new ambassadorial show, he takes on a character unlike any he has before, with a personality entirely opposite his own.

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What do I have in common with Thorpe...? Why does he look up to the stars...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ugh! The more I think about it, the less I understand him!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Tenma, how many times do I need to tell you? Keep it down!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
I-I'm sorry!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Sigh*
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We only have a few days left until our show opens... And I'm not about to become the reason why it's going to suffer in terms of quality...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: More importantly, a star's supposed to be able to be a shining example for others to follow! “Good enough” just isn't good enough in my book!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And yet, I'm unable to participate in practices right now...! All I'm doing is just...! Argh! Get it together, Tsukasa Tenma!
Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? That voice...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Toya!
Fancy seeing you here all alone. You're not with Akito today?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito unfortunately has to take supplementary classes today... But we still have to practice later as a team, so I have to go on ahead without him.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Anyway, is something wrong...?
You seem to have quite a bit on your mind.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The truth is, I'm having trouble getting into character for our next show...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Getting into character...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. We're doing “A Pianist Named Thorpe” with me as the protagonist, but I've been holding up practices because I'm having trouble understanding my character's personality...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
“A Pianist Named Thorpe”...?
That's a very famous story. I remember reading it over and over again because of how much I liked it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What? Is that true?
Wait, that means...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Toya has a talent for dissecting and understanding these kinds of stories. He's also known me for a very long time.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He might be the one who can give me a hint...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Toya, please!
Will you help me with understanding my character?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm currently trying to discover what Thorpe and I have in common, but so far I've had no luck...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, you're familiar with both me and this story. You may be the key to solving this puzzle!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
What you both have in common...?
Yes, I think I can help you with that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also, I'm very interested in seeing how you portray Thorpe...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Alright, why don't we find somewhere to sit down and chat?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Toya...! You're a model gentleman...!
I promise to pay back this debt!
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
A very cute cafe.
With many female patrons, I see.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Welcome!
Huh...? Tsukasa? Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Saki?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, this is where Saki works!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yay! Thanks for visiting, you guys!
Lemme show you to your table! Over here!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll have a coffee.
No milk or sugar.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I'll have some iced tea!
Oh, can I get a lemon slice with that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Coffee and iced tea!
Coming right up♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright...
Let's get down to business...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What do Thorpe and I have in common? Does anything come to mind?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Right.
Mind if I take a look at your script first?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course!!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, this sounds very tricky...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My impression going in was that you two didn't have much in common, but reading this script may've only made that worse...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You think so too, Toya...?
Hmm... Even though I'm looking for just one thing...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What if you took the opposite approach instead? By seeing how you both contrast, you may end up discovering some surprising commonalities.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah! That's a great idea!
Let's see how we differ!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: First... We take on challenges in remarkably different ways!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. In your case, Tsukasa, you like to do absolutely everything in your power to overcome an obstacle.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And you wouldn't take out your frustrations on little animals like he does here. You'd probably take what needs work and keep hammering away at it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Y-You think so...?
I suppose you might be right...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also, you'd never turn away a sick animal. There's no way you could ever do anything cruel to someone with an illness.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tsukasa, you're also...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks for your patience!
Here's your coffee and iced tea...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: ...someone who likes to stay positive and upbeat while taking charge of things. You're very honest and are quick to apologize when you think you've done something wrong.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes! That's right!
Hah hah hah hah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, keep it down...
You're gonna embarrass me in front of everyone...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In the end, we only realized just how much we differ...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes...
Fifty things at that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I really am the polar opposite of Thorpe...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Especially the scene where he looks up to the stars the night before the contest. I still can't wrap my head around that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The stars...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. He knows the contest is creeping up on him, but his eyes wander toward the stars in the sky... I just don't understand...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't think his eyes are wandering.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In this story, Thorpe looks up to the stars whenever he incurs a setback...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I feel like there's a hidden meaning behind him looking up to the stars like this.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A hidden meaning? Such as...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That I can't really say...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Setbacks...
When he's facing a massive hurdle...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hang on...
se_event_star_2022_002
Ten years ago
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: How's that?! A performance fit for a star, I'd say! Mom taught me how to play that!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
That was amazing, Tsukasa!
I wanna try playing “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” too!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You do?! In that case, I'll teach you!
That way, we'll both be able to play it!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
Yay!
You're the best, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, Saki, let's take it one step at a time so you can learn to play four hands with him.

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
Okay!
*Cough*

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, maybe we shouldn't today...
You did just get back from the hospital.

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
No! I wanna play!
I wanna play “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star!”

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I know...!
I can teach you while you're in bed!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: There are some good finger drills you can still practice, so we can give some of those a try!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, but we'll start tomorrow.
For now, you need to get a good night's rest!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
Grr... Fine...
Why can't it be tomorrow already?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Okay, let's get you back to bed.

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright...!
se_event_star_2022_002

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I have to practice lots if I'm gonna teach Saki how to play this!)

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
*Sob*
It hurts so much...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Saki...?!
Saki, are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line:
I'll get the car!
Keep an eye on her while I do.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Good morning! Saki, let's practice... Huh? Mom, where's Saki?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: So... Saki came down with something last night and is at the hospital now.

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?! She's back at the hospital?!
Is she okay?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Yes. Fortunately, your father got word this morning that it's nothing serious.

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh... Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But that means she's gonna be really sad again...)

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: I wish we can play the piano together soon...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Turn here and...
“Haha! I am the great hero, Pegasus!
Here to vanquish all that is evil!”

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Who could that be?
Hello, this is the Tenmas!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: <Tsukasa, is that you? I'm sorry to disappoint you like this, but Saki still isn't feeling well so she needs to stay a little longer.>

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: <Your father will be home soon, so please try to be patient for just a bit longer.>

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay, got it...!
I'll be good while I wait!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: <Hehe. Thank you for being such a wonderful big brother. We'll talk again soon.>

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: They're gonna be gone really long again...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, I'm a star! This shouldn't bother me at all! Saki probably feels worse because she doesn't get to be home...!
se_event_star_2022_003

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki... At this rate, you won't ever get a chance to catch up to me... Please, come home soon.
